title: Lixity — local manuscript analysis and research workbench for authors
description: Lixity is a local workbench for authors, with a browser app, CLI and Python API. Deterministic manuscript analysis covers sentence rhythm, lexical diversity, language-calibrated readability, dialogue, paragraph-level tense and self-calibrating style references with robust statistics. Exact passages connect to retained sources, claims and revisioned research dossiers. PDF and static reading-website exports make explicitly selected material shareable; read-only project inspection distinguishes sources and outputs without moving files or asserting output freshness. The core analysis engine runs offline in pure Python. Explicit optional local syntax models provide contextual verb-group tense analysis in seven languages. Shared project audio profiles drive CLI and browser rendering through optional Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice, with bounded jobs, local or configured Jetson execution and atomic listening-copy exports. Statistical signals support human review, not literary-quality scores; archive integrity does not establish factual truth.
notes: Deposited from a tagged GitHub release of the software.
